taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: FEIS species review, Vaccinium membranaceum (Simonin 2000): "shrub with stems ranging from 12 to 47 inches (30-120 cm) in height".

traits.height_max_m.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium membranaceum: "Erect branching shrub, 1-2 m. high".

traits.life_span.note: FEIS species review, Vaccinium membranaceum (Simonin 2000): "individual stems are capable of producing fruit for 14 years", from long-lived clones.

traits.woodiness.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium membranaceum: "Erect branching shrub".

traits.leaf_habit.note: FEIS species review, Vaccinium membranaceum (Simonin 2000): "Leaf fall is initiated in mid-August"; Abrams's key (1951 p. 327): "Leaves not coriaceous, deciduous".

traits.clonal.note: FEIS species review, Vaccinium membranaceum (Simonin 2000): "Populations are usually maintained through lateral expansion of vegetative clones".

traits.rhizome_habit.note: FEIS species review, Vaccinium membranaceum (Simonin 2000): "Thinleaf huckleberry is rhizomatous"; "Rhizomes are usually found within the 3.15 to 11.8 inch (8-30 cm) range of a soil profile", spreading the clone sideways.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: FEIS species review, Vaccinium membranaceum (Simonin 2000): "Leaves are alternate, elliptic to oblong".

traits.leaf_shape.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium membranaceum: "Leaves ovate to oval or obovate"; FEIS (Simonin 2000): "elliptic to oblong"; read as ovate, as most photos show.

traits.leaf_apex.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium membranaceum: leaves "varying from acute to obtuse or occasionally rounded at apex".

traits.leaf_margin.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium membranaceum: leaves "serrulate, thin and rather membranaceous".

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium membranaceum: leaves "2-6 cm. long"; FEIS (Simonin 2000): "ranging from 0.7 to 2.75 inches (1.8-7 cm) long", kept as the rare extremes.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 8 p. 516 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Vaccinium membranaceum: "Leaf blades usually green, broadly elliptic to ovate, 25-50 x 11-23 mm, margins sharply serrate".

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium membranaceum: "petioles 1-2 mm. long".

traits.leaf_colour_autumn.note: Leaves turning red to crimson in autumn, colouring whole slopes; sRGB by eye, set by hand from iNaturalist photos (observations 247203028, 87283178, 54277742, 187333298, 57290374, 294264226, 58885991, 58885923): the sources read give no count or measure.

traits.inflorescence.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium membranaceum: "flowers solitary in the axils".

traits.flowering_position.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium membranaceum: "flowers solitary in the axils".

traits.flower_posture.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium membranaceum: "pedicels recurved in flower, erect in fruit".

traits.corolla_shape.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium membranaceum: "corolla yellowish, depressed-globose or globose-urceolate".

traits.flower_size_m.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium membranaceum: corolla "4-5 mm. in diameter".

traits.flower_colour.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium membranaceum: "corolla yellowish"; sRGB by eye, a pale creamy yellow tinged pink.

traits.fruit_type.note: FEIS species review, Vaccinium membranaceum (Simonin 2000): "The fruit is a berry".

traits.fruit_shape.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium membranaceum: berry "globose".

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 8 p. 516 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Vaccinium membranaceum: "Berries shiny or dull black or deep purple, rarely red or white, 9-13 mm diam."; Abrams (1951 p. 328): "7-10 mm. in diameter", kept as the low.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium membranaceum: "berry dark wine-colored or purplish black, without bloom"; sRGB by eye.

traits.flowering_months.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium membranaceum: "June-July"; FEIS (Simonin 2000): in Montana "flowering begins the 1st week of June".

traits.fruiting_months.note: Ripe berries in August and September, set by hand from iNaturalist photos (observations 247203028, 87283178, 54277742, 187333298, 57290374, 294264226, 58885991, 58885923): the sources read give no count or measure.

generator.params.note: Red huckleberry's (vaccinium-parvifolium) values, changed by hand for big huckleberry: a smaller, knee- to waist-high shrub (FEIS: stems 30-120 cm) with shorter internodes and single nodding flowers in the leaf axils. Not fitted to measurements.

appearance.organs.bloom.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 328, Vaccinium membranaceum: "flowers solitary in the axils; pedicels recurved in flower"; "corolla yellowish, depressed-globose or globose-urceolate, 4-5 mm. in diameter"; "berry dark wine-colored or purplish black, without bloom, globose, 7-10 mm.". Drawn as a creamy urn about half the dark berry's size. Resized 2026-10-19 to Flora of North America vol. 8 p. 516 (eFloras): berries "9-13 mm diam.", corolla "3-5 x 5-7 mm": the urn is 0.4 of the 11 mm berry.

appearance.note: By eye, from the photos the traits cite: an erect, open shrub of thin, bright green, finely toothed ovate leaves on angled twigs, with small creamy urns and dark purple-black berries, crimson in autumn. Organ cards from red huckleberry's (vaccinium-parvifolium), recoloured and resized by hand. Colours set by eye were written as screen (sRGB) shades; they are read as the linear light a colour field holds, and bark and foliage follow the stated colour traits by rule (2026-10-19).

allometry.note: 0.8 m tall at 12 years in the open, within its sources' range, as it grows in subalpine parkland. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

traits.stem_clump.note: Flora of North America vol. 8 p. 516 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Vaccinium membranaceum: "Plants forming small to extensive clumps, rarely crown-forming, 2-30 dm".

traits.twig_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 8 p. 516 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Vaccinium membranaceum: "twigs of current season yellow-green or reddish green, terete to slightly angled"; sRGB a model estimate (confidence medium) of a yellow-green.

generator.params.bloom_size.note: Flora of North America vol. 8 p. 516 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Vaccinium membranaceum: "Berries ... 9-13 mm diam.": the bloom card is drawn as the ripe berry, 11 mm across, its flower look 0.4 of that (corolla "3-5 x 5-7 mm"; Abrams 1951 p. 328: "4-5 mm. in diameter").

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy added for the Mount Rainier subalpine meadow scene (2026-10-19): sizes and forms from Abrams and FEIS, counts and colours from iNaturalist photos, drawing values from a built-in template.
